purpose: Presentation-only ESO gear, skill, passive, and Champion Point history. Never used by mechanics/runtime calculations.

events.name: Serpent's Disdain
events.summary: Released with a 5-piece bonus that increases the duration of Status Effects you apply by 16 seconds.
events.source: ZOS PC/Mac Patch Notes v8.0.5 - High Isle & Update 34

events.name: Pillager's Profit
events.summary: Released with its Ultimate-support 5-piece granting 5% of Ultimate spent per tick, up to 20 Ultimate, to as many as 11 nearby group members over 10 seconds, with a 45-second recipient cooldown.
events.source: ZOS PC/Mac Patch Notes v8.0.5 - High Isle & Update 34

events.name: Pillager's Profit
events.summary: Fixed the set so its Ultimate-support effect no longer targets pets, which cannot receive Ultimate.
events.source: ZOS PC/Mac Patch Notes v9.1.5 - Update 39

events.name: Pillager's Profit
events.summary: Ultimate granted per tick was reduced to 2% of Ultimate spent, down from 5%.
events.source: ZOS PC/Mac Patch Notes v11.0.5 - Update 46

events.name: Combat Prayer
events.summary: Healing was increased as part of the Restoration Staff healing pass; rank progression changed from added healing efficiency to reduced cost, and Minor Berserk stopped applying to pets because pets already inherit their owner's Minor Berserk.
events.source: ZOS PC/Mac Patch Notes v5.1.5 - Scalebreaker & Update 23
